title: McMoneagle tells Jesse that humans may be turning into the ETs

tellings.quote: he said that I think we might be turning into these etss or something they might be sort of prompting us to turn into some of them

plain: Humans might be slowly turning into the extraterrestrials, or the beings might be nudging us to become like them. Michels says a man named Joe McMoneagle told him this on a phone call, putting it as "I think we might be turning into these ETs or something." If true, the visitors would be less outsiders than a picture of our own future.
